CALCIUM SUPPLEMENTS
Calcium carbonate is the most common and least expensive 
calcium supplement. It can be difficult to digest and causes gas 
and constipation in some people. Calcium carbonate is 40% 
elemental calcium; 1000 mg will provide 400 mg of calcium. 
This supplement should be taken with food to aid in absorption. 
Taking magnesium with it can help to prevent constipation.
